QUOTE: `memory_buffer_alloc.c` is a built-in consumer of the runtime hook. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` installs its own calloc/free at lines 570-575 (a mutex-wrapped pair when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the buffer allocator as a consumer of the runtime setter that installs its own calloc/free from its init function, but it never says it is the *only* in-tree user, which I judged immaterial to the core fact.
